name: BNB Chain
executive_summary: BNB Smart Chain launched in 2020, built for cheap, high-volume execution rather than maximum decentralization, and roughly six years later at the time of this scoring that tradeoff still shows: an On-Chain Health score of 86 built on roughly 4 million daily active users, against a Decentralization score of just 38. The TradFi score of 69 is also shaped by a 2022 security incident that's still working its way off the books through a multi-year clean track record. The AI score of 68 lands just one point below the TradFi score, the closest the two axes have come together for this chain, reflecting fast settlement and solid agent-identity tooling offset by weak on-chain privacy.

key_findings: Security Posture sits at Partial through the remediation clock applied to the 2022 Token Hub exploit -- 3.5 clean years plus the Fusion structural remediation aged it up from a would-be Fail.
The Security Posture cap (70) no longer binds: raw 69.29 falls below it, so the published score is the raw. A future gate upgrade now changes the gate row rather than the score.
On-Chain Health (86) is elite-broad -- ~4M+ daily active users, 31M peak daily transactions, though measured partly under an active gas-subsidy campaign.
Privacy & Confidentiality (46) -- no protocol-level confidentiality, but a functioning application-layer privacy ecosystem on a full-EVM chain, with no shielding available for BNB itself.
Fast full-EVM execution profile -- 0.45s blocks, ~0.65s average deterministic finality, 5,200 TPS benchmark throughput.
KYA (63) carries strong agent-identity registration depth -- ERC-8004 registries live since Feb 2026 with ~89k registered agents, plus the native BAP-578 standard.
Deterministic Finality Partial cap (75) does not bind -- BNB retains a probabilistic fallback path that holds the gate at Partial despite fast normal-mode speed.

watch_items: Watch for a tier-1 audit commission of the modern, heavily-diverged bsc client -- would close the sole gap holding the Security Posture gate at Partial. Note the cap no longer binds, so this is now a gate-row change rather than a score change.
0-Fee Stablecoin Carnival subsidy is still running -- re-assess On-Chain Health once it lapses.
BNB's announced agent-purpose L1 (late-2026 testnet target) would be a new chain to score, not a BNB re-credit, when it ships.
